use_case: Transaction fraud-detection model scoring every authorization (card-present and card-not-present) and driving automatic declines above a threshold
vendor_or_model: Licensed machine learning model from a fraud analytics vendor, hosted in the company's cloud tenant (SYS-09); vendor retrains quarterly on a labeled extract
data_categories: Tokens (never PAN); transaction amount, time, and merchant category; BIN country and card type; billing ZIP code; device and IP signals for card-not-present; fraud and chargeback labels
consequential_decision_category: None of the listed categories directly (the issuer makes the credit decision). High tier because it runs inline in payment infrastructure and declines consumer purchases automatically
human_in_the_loop: No human before real-time declines (not feasible at 45 per second). Compensating design: automatic decline only at the top score band; middle band goes to step-up authentication or merchant review; analysts review escalations and a monthly override sample; merchants can allow-list customers
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45 (claims to merchants; unfair practices); 16 CFR 314.4(f) (vendor oversight of the training extract); PCI DSS 3.2.1 and 12.8 (extract content and provider); Colorado SB26-189 (effective 2027-01-01) applicability to be assessed by counsel

use_case: Staff use of generative AI chatbots to draft merchant emails, summarize tickets, and write code snippets
vendor_or_model: Public consumer chatbots today; enterprise AI assistant with no-training terms approved 2026-08-31
data_categories: Risk of card numbers, merchant names with transaction details, and security configurations being pasted
risk_tier: Medium (Low once public chatbots are blocked and the enterprise tool is in use)
human_in_the_loop: Staff review every output before use; no automated actions
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 314.4(c)(1) and (f) (customer information disclosed to an unapproved provider); PCI DSS 12.2.1 (acceptable use) and 3.2.1 (no PAN outside the CDE)
status: Public chatbots prohibited for work (POL-05 4.7); enterprise assistant rollout by 2026-10-31
